title: You Definitely Need this!!
text: Exceeded expectations and HIGHLY Recommended!  The car was clean and safe, and our guides were incredibly knowledgable, friendly, and accommodating.  They knew all the best places to go, especiallly ones that we would not have seen if touring on our own.  Please please do yourself a favor and do this.  Very trustworthy, and we could not have been happier.  This really made our trip to Spain special and memorable!!
author: Susan_R

title: Great personal tour of Barcelona
text: It was a fantastic tour.  Picked up right in front of my hotel - the tour guide and driver were both there early, so as soon as I walked out we were ready to go.  Gave me a great tour of Barcelona, and were even able to work around some roads that were closed on that particular day.  Absolutely fantastic!
author: Extraordinary602715

title: Great BCN experiences
text: I have used this company a few times now over several years for Barcelona transfers from the airport as well as a four hour private vehicle for sightseeing. Everything is always great! Thank you so much for your help again with our transfers from the airport to the cruise terminal. Do not hesitate booking them. They are a very reputable and professional company.

author: ht635

title: An unforgettable experience
text:
We decided to hire a private tour to visit Barcelona and contacted Tour Travel & More. The experience has been unforgettable. Everything was perfectly organized. We enjoyed a wonderful Sunday in the company of our guide, Angels, who showed us an incredible Barcelona with all kinds of historical, artistic and even social explanations of bourgeois society of the 19th and 20th century. It was very interesting.
Thank you so much!

author: H3395KVtonic

title: Great option to see Barcelona
text:
Our driver and guide took us around Barcelona showing us the highlights.  They let us spend as much time in each location as we wanted, which was great.  They know the best spots for pictures.

It was nice to be in an air conditioned vehicle while driving around to see sites.  We stopped and walked around in a few places.

Guide was knowledgeable, van was clean and cool.

When booking this tour, we couldn’t decide between this tour and a tuktuk.  This tour, the van, was definitely the right call as we were able to cover much more territory than a tuktuk.
